tools.name: scan_token
tools.description: Full token security scan. Args: address (0x...), chain (ethereum|base|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bsc|avalanche). Risk score 0-100 from our on-chain checks plus GoPlus. Not an audit.

tools.name: honeypot_check
tools.description: Fast honeypot check. Args: address (0x...), chain. Returns: honeypot boolean, canBuy, canSell, buyTax, sellTax, riskScore.

tools.name: simulate_transfer
tools.description: Simulate buy-then-sell on-chain. Args: address (0x...), chain. Returns: canBuy, canSell, revertReason, verdict (ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK). Uses real eth_call simulation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_token" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
